title: sevenz-rust2: decompress builds each output path as dest.join(entry.name()) with no traversal guard, allowing a…
description: The sevenz-rust2 library versions prior to 0.21.1 contain a directory traversal vulnerability during extraction of 7z archives. The extractor joins each entry's path onto the destination directory without normalization or checks, allowing crafted archive entries with paths like '../../etc/cron.d/x' or absolute paths to write files outside the intended extraction directory. This can lead to arbitrary file writes, potentially overwriting critical system or application files and enabling code execution or persistence. The issue was fixed in version 0.21.1.
